Path: write metadata — the form designer by keyboard and screen reader | 缺项 | P3

## Triage: first grade, `bug` · `priority:p3` · `domain:ui` · `area:studio` · `pm:queue`. Direction as the body proposes

Triage seat (objectstack-wide, seat post objectstack-ai/objectstack#6015) · `session_01AavokzJ5DndAwitDXvKy4U` · 2026-10-07T17:26Z. ⛔ Not a claim, ⛔ not a dispatch.

Triage: lands in the form designer's drag-and-drop context (its `dnd-kit` live-region announcements) ⇒ `domain:ui`; rationale: a Studio or console surface in objectui. Filed from the browser QA pass of 2026-10-07 (objectstack `879bd38c`, objectui `179f6fe9`); paths re-read on objectui `main` `9990f9e122`.

- **Why p3:** a screen-reader user hears internal ids; the move itself works.
- **Direction:**
  - pass localized `announcements` that name the field label, the group label and the position
- `Clause-②: no`. Patch changeset in objectui.

Claim: PM loop round 8
Session: `session_01DrKzdPdyLLBW3qpZ4vtk7z`
Account: `huangyiirene`
Branch: `claude/issue-11802-form-dnd-announcements`
Worktree: `objectui-issue-11802`
Domain: `domain:ui`
Seat: `domain:ui#1`
File surface (line numbers on `5aa7f55`):
- `packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/ObjectFormDesigner.tsx`: the `DndContext` props only (about `:573`–`:620`). Add an `accessibility` prop with localized `announcements` and screen-reader instructions, naming the field label, the group label and the position.
- One new module-private announcements helper beside it, if the context's props grow past a few lines.
- New `engine.studio.formDnd.*` rows of `packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/i18n.ts`, EN and ZH.
- The tests beside these, and `.changeset/11802-*.md`.

⛔ Not on it:
- **Seat 2's objectui#11781** (claim `6049679587`): the "Drag to reorder … click a field to edit its properties" hint, wherever it renders (`engine.studio.designer.hint`), and the Form tab's layout caption.
- `isKeptOffLayout` and the designer's layout model, as objectui#11780 left them. The drag handlers' behaviour (`onDragStart` / `onDragOver` / `onDragEnd`) does not change.
- `@dnd-kit/*` versions, and any `package.json` change.
- `packages/components/src/ui/**` and `packages/i18n/**`.

Any file outside this list: the dev reports it before opening the PR (stop on breach; explain in the report).
Container & model: `M`, `mode:subagent`, `model: opus` (`dispatch-gates --tier --repo objectstack-ai/objectui` over these paths: no path-derived mandate; default tier)
Clause-②: no
Responsibility: `objectui app-shell Studio: the form designer's DndContext passes no announcements, so dnd-kit reads its internal ids ("Draggable item f:name was dropped over droppable area g:new_group") to screen-reader users, in English whatever the locale | the platform path is right: dnd-kit takes localized announcements through DndContext's accessibility prop | every screen-reader user arranging a form in Studio, measured by the filer in the 2026-10-07 QA pass`
Thread-read: 6043167024
Serial constraints cleared: `none` blocking.
- **`area:studio` in flight:**
  - seat 2's objectui#11781, #11791, #11792, #11797 and #11800;
  - seat 3's objectui#11786 and #11796;
  - this seat's objectui#11823.

  Their claims were read 2026-10-08T02:06Z. Only objectui#11781 names `ObjectFormDesigner.tsx`, and then only the designer hint, which this surface leaves alone. Every card adds `i18n.ts` rows under its own prefix.
- **Open objectui PRs:** objectui#11850, #11851, #11852 and #11853. None touches `ObjectFormDesigner.tsx`. Also open: #11844/#11845 (dependabot), #11600 (release) and #11069. Read 2026-10-08T02:06Z.
- **This seat:** dispatch is parallel, `batch` 3, on the maintainer's word in this session's chat: 「改为并行派发，batch 3」, and 「继续派发」 today.
  - The batch counts working devs.
  - objectui#11838 (PR objectui#11850, in the merge queue) and #11798 (PR objectui#11852, CI converging) have no dev working.
  - Working with this card: objectui#11823's dev and objectui#11801's.

Why `Clause-②: no`: the announcements are a prop of a module-internal component's `DndContext`. No export, prop, `@object-ui/types` member, accepted input or `packages/i18n` key is added. App-shell's `ENGINE_STRINGS` are unexported.
